newsitem.title: SLOVAKIA: SLOVAK TATRA BANKA SAYS TO LAUNCH 3-YR BOND.
newsitem.headline: SLOVAK TATRA BANKA SAYS TO LAUNCH 3-YR BOND.

text.p: Slovak commercial bank Tatra Banka a.s. on Friday said it would launch a three-year, one-billion crown bond issue early next year.
The bond issue, approved by an extraordinary shareholders' meeting on Friday, will be made once the bank's board of directors agrees on the final details.
"The board will determine the details of the issue early in January which will correspond to the conditions on the Slovak capital market at the time," Tatra bank spokesman Ivan Bednar told Reuters.
Tatra Banka currently disposes of large amounts of primary, mainly short-term, deposits, while many clients prefer longer-term loans with a fixed interest rate, the bank said in a statement.
The bank will use the funds from the issue for expansion and the gradual transformation of its liabilities into longer-term resources with fixed interest rates.
